summary: Completed backend API and frontend UI/integration testing for the Lewis Hamilton fan site on the external preview URL. Core flows pass; primary issue is external image request failures causing console errors.

integration_issues.issue: Multiple Wikimedia image requests fail with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB, resulting in broken/missing images and console request failures.

action_items: Replace hotlinked Wikimedia images with assets served from a stable allowed host/CDN to avoid ORB blocking.
Re-run browser test to verify no failed requests in console and all key section images render consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js currently catches archive fetch errors and sets archive to null silently; add an explicit UI error state so failures are visible and testable.
App.css is heavily minified into a single large line, reducing maintainability and reviewability; format/split stylesheet for easier long-term upkeep.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/archive is stable and validated against required stats/seasons/tracks/victory count. Frontend interactions (menu links, car controls, quotes, filters, archive toggle, back-to-top, mobile overflow/readability) passed. Focus retest on image hosting fix and console request-failure cleanup.
rca of the issue: RCA: Broken images are due to external host response handling (Wikimedia hotlinks) triggering browser net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB, not local selector/render logic. Repro: load preview URL and inspect console/network; impacted image URLs fail and corresponding elements can have naturalWidth=0. Mitigation: serve same images via app-controlled/static/CDN host with compatible headers and CORS behavior.
